data.name: Deluxe Kona Snorkel Adventure (2 snorkel spots)
data.headline: Ages 6+ • 4 Hours on the water • Snorkel two of Kona’s best spots on one trip!
data.description:
Enjoy the two best snorkeling locations in one trip. Providing guests with snorkeling, as well as cultural, and environmental information relevant to the Island of Hawaii and its history. Your captain will also show you several spectacular, unique volcanic geological phenomena including sea caves and lava tubes.

KEALAKEKUA BAY: Kealakekua Bay is a well-known historical site and underwater marine sanctuary. The large bay is situated to ensure calm waters year round and one of our best Kona snorkeling tours. The waters here are clear, offering great visibility. Kealakekua Bay is home to over 100 different varieties of tropical fish. We may even spot some dolphin as we leave.

HONAUNAU BAY: Located off Pu’uhonua O Hōnaunau National Historic Park often referred to as the “Place of Refuge” is a famous snorkeling location. Honaunau Bay is a uniquely beautiful. Snorkeling here is quite different than snorkeling Kealakekua Bay and the waters have exceptional visibility most of the year. You get to explore beautiful coral shelves with white sandy patches in between. It is here that you might get to see a Honu (Hawaiian Green Sea Turtle).

highlight_box.title: Snorkel Two Historic Reefs

data.highlights:
Join us to see the underwater beauty near Captain Cook's Monument and Puuhonua O Honaunau National Historic Park. Usually, at this time of day, the waters of the Kona coast are crystal clear and offer great visibility. View over 100 different varieties of tropical fish along with an occasional reef shark or sea turtle. These lively snorkeling spots are home to a variety of marine life. 

Your Crew will teach you a little Hawaiian history along the way. As you cruise, you will enjoy spectacular views of Big Island's rugged coastline, along with views of sea caves and lava tubes. If you are lucky, you may spot a pod of dolphins or a whale, which can be found here year-round (humpback whale migration is seasonal!)
data.itinerary:
1) You'll want to sign your waivers in advance to prevent any delays with your tour.
2) Meet us at our check-in location in the Keauhou Shopping Center, 78-6831 Ali‘i Dr Suite F-146, Kailua-Kona, HI 96740.  We are located behind Tropics restaurant.  
Or type "Dolphin Discoveries-Snorkel Tour Check-in and Boutique" on Google maps for directions.
3) Check-in and receive your snorkeling gear and directions to our meeting spot at Keauhou Bay.
4) Drive 1.4 miles or 5 minutes to Keauhou Bay.  Park along the street.
5) Meet our crew at the meeting location.
6) Depart Keauhou Bay to Kealakekua Bay (Captain Cook Monument).
7) Depart to Honaunau Bay.
8) Depart to Sea Caves and Lava Tubes.
8) Return to departure point.  There is no need to return to the check-in location.

data.cancellation_summary: To receive a full refund, travelers may cancel up to 48 hours before the experience start time in the local time zone. No refunds will be given after that time period.
data.cancellation_notes:
Prior to booking, please note that we enforce a 48 hour cancellation/reschedule policy.  Should you need to cancel, you will be provided a full refund or replacement gift card, if applicable, with 48 hours notice.  No refund will be issued for cancellations with less than 48 hours notice, for any reason.   In the event that rescheduling is not possible, no refund will be issued with less than 48 hours notice.  If you do not show for your scheduled tour, no refund or reschedule will be provided.  We do not offer "credits" for cancellations with less than 48 hours notice or no shows.

For private charters, there is a 7 day cancellation policy prior to departure time to receive a full refund.

If you purchased trip assurance, you will be issued a refund of the tour price plus tax or a one time reschedule.  The trip assurance fee is non-refundable. No refunds will be given if we do not receive a call or "no shows". Trip Assurance is not available for private charters.

A processing fee is added when booking online.  This fee is only refundable if the tour is fully refunded within the cancellation policy.  Refunds of this fee does not apply to partial cancellations.

Ocean Stewardship Fee "OSF".  The State of Hawai'i has implemented an Ocean Stewardship Fee to be collected in the amount of $1.00 per guest.  This fee is submitted directly to the State for ocean conservation programs. 

If you booked through a partner of Dolphin Discoveries (TripAdvisor, Viator, Groupon), please refer to their cancellation policies.

Gift Card purchases are non-refundable. 

Wildlife: Please keep in mind that our adventures are wild and free. There is no guarantee when it comes to wild animals.

If you purchased our Manta Ray Guarantee Ticket, if for any reason we are unable to view Manta Rays on the day and time you have joined us, we will gladly offer you an opportunity go out a second time at no additional charge on a space available basis. If we do not have space available or you are unable to reschedule, there are no refunds. Our Manta Guarantee is not applicable if you purchased tickets through a third party vendor. 

If you booked our Whale and Dolphin watch, there are no refunds or reschedules if we do not view dolphins on the day and time you have joined us.

Guest Minimums: Please note that we have guest minimums for a tour to run.  If, for some reason, we do not meet our requirement we will call or email you to reschedule your tour for another day during your stay or offer a different tour.  If you are unable to reschedule, you will be issued a full refund.

Weather: The Kona Coast is blessed with the best weather, least rain, and calmest water in the state. The occasional gloomy sky can quickly turn sunny.  For this reason our highly experienced Captains will assess ocean conditions 30 minutes prior to tour departure.  No trip will be cancelled prior to 30 minutes before its scheduled time of departure. If the trip is cancelled due to unsafe ocean conditions, we will make every effort to reschedule your trip (subject to availability) for a later time during your stay on the island. If that is not possible, you will be issued a full refund.  We do run rain or shine.  

We reserve the right to cancel for any reason including weather, ocean conditions, mechanical problems or safety of our guests or crew. If for any reason we must cancel on the date and time you have scheduled, we will gladly reschedule your tour for a different day.  If you are unable to reschedule, we will provide you with a full refund or replacement gift card, if applicable.
data.booking_notes:
**IMPORTANT INFORMATION BELOW:**

Please take a moment to watch our video regarding what to expect for your upcoming Deluxe Kona Snorkel Adventure by clicking the link to our YouTube Video below:

[Know Before You Go](https://youtu.be/3NuUk1Js_OA)

NEXT STEPS:

1. Sign our e-waiver upon receipt of this email by clicking the "Sign Waiver" link above.  Complete **ONE** on-line waiver for **EACH** person in your party.  Minors can be included with one parent or guardians waiver.  This email can be forwarded to everyone in your group so that they have access to the waiver link.

2. Check in is at our retail location in the Keauhou Shopping Center, 78-6831 Alii Drive. (park near Tropics Tap House and walk into the center).  Detailed check in times noted below. (click the "meet us at" link above).
  
3. You will drive to Keauhou Bay, 78-100 Kaleiopapa St, Kailua-Kona, HI 96740, where the crew will meet you for your tour. (click the "we will end at" link above).

Transportation to our retail location and to Keauhou Bay is the responsibility of the guests.  If you are taking an Uber, please add a first stop and second stop to your reservation so that the driver will wait for you at the retail location to take you to Keauhou Bay 

You do not need to return to our retail location after the tour unless you would like a souvenir!

**CHECK IN AND TOUR TIMES **

•	Tour Check in time – 8am (Store does not open until 8am)
•	Tour Departs Keauhou Bay – 9am
•	Tour returns to Keauhou Bay – 1pm

**INCLUDED WITH YOUR TOUR:**
• All snorkel gear (prescription masks available for rent)
• Pool Noodles
• Bottled water, aloha juices, fresh fruit and light snacks 

**WHAT TO BRING:**
Please wear your swimsuit, shoes that are easy to kick off, light cover-up, towel and hat, if desired.  Tips for your crew always appreciated.

**SUNSCREEN LAW:**

**BRING REEF SAFE SUNSCREEN LOTION ONLY (spray on sunscreen will not be allowed)** -  WHEN SHOPPING, PLEASE CHOOSE A ZINC OR MINERAL BASED SUNSCREEN. For your convenience, we sell 3oz. tubes of sunscreen that meets Hawai'i's reef safe requirements.  (Please check that it does **NOT** contain these ingredients:  **oxybenzone, octinoxate, avobenzone or octocrylene**).  

**PARKING AT KEAUHOU BAY:**  As you turn onto Kaleiopapa Street, there is free "ON THE STREET" parking on the left and right.  Find an open spot to park and walk down until you see the boat ramp area on the left.  Be mindful of the no parking areas. DO NOT park in the boat trailer parking, boat wash down area or block any driveways.  Once parked, please wait near the restrooms across from the boat ramps. Once all guests are checked in at the retail location, your crew will meet you to start the trip.

##NEED TO KNOW:##
Guests must be comfortable with swimming. 
Minimum age: 6yrs old
Minors must be accompanied by an adult at all times whether in the water or on the boat

**Additional Info:**
There is a storage box on the boat for a small bag with personal items.

Please take a moment to review our FAQ's page on our website where you can find answers to many questions.  

https://www.dolphindiscoveries.com/faq/

Informational Videos:
[What To Bring](https://youtu.be/t2M4rp7Fj_0)
[Equipment Fitting](https://youtu.be/3m9u_dimWyo)
